messages:
maria_gomez: Heads up: planning Equinox dedicated rollout THU 11pm PT (2024-06-15 23:00 PT). Need signoff for: KV cache drain/flush, quantization profile v3 pin, and traffic-hold window. @kevin_wong @sasha_patil @jon_lee please ack. Rolling canary 5%->50%->100% over 30m windows.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created rollout ticket RI-4821. Canary schedule: 2024-06-16T06:00:00Z (canary start). Canary checks: latency p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.5%. Auto-rollback on regression. /run plan attached.

kevin_wong: Are we sure quant profile v3 has perf numbers for 1k seq? previous test showed p95 spike. Need verified perf profile or fallback to v2.

jon_lee: If we hit >300ms p95 or >1% errors for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> rollback to model:v2-quant. I'll add thresholds to the deploybot.

sasha_patil: Customer comms: send advance notif to Equinox Ops with change window + rollback plan. I can draft — what wording for KV cache drain? how long does drain take?

maria_gomez: KV cache flush expected ~90s per shard but drain + warmup ~6-8m. We'll do a soft-drain during canary ramp: prefix cache warmup on v3. Plan: drain shard-by-shard, leave primary KV for 10% traffic for warm cache.

ops-runner: Ops checklist updated: run `scripts/kv/flush.sh --shard <id>` then monitor `kv-warmup` metric. Add a 10m hold after full traffic to watch tails.

jon_lee: Rolling config snippet:
```
canary: [5, 50, 100]
windows_mins: [10, 10, 10]
rollback_on:
  - p95 > 300ms for 2 windows
  - error_rate > 1% for 2 windows
model_pin: model:equinox-v1-quant-v3
fallback: model:equinox-v1-quant-v2
```
I'll attach to the ticket.

kevin_wong: :thumbsup: I'll run a 1k-seq perf test against v3 in staging tonight and post numbers.

sasha_patil: Also request a release note blurb + config diff for customer portal. Maria can you add short blurb?

maria_gomez: Added release notes to ticket: 'Improved inference throughput via v3 quantization; temporary traffic-hold during shard warmup. Expected brief increase in p95 during warmup, monitoring in place.'

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled. Locking model pin `equinox-v1-quant-v3` for rollout. Ticket RI-4821 updated with canary-monitor links. React with :rocket: to approve or :no_entry: to block.

kevin_wong: :rocket: from me if perf numbers look good post-test. Will update by 21:30 PT.

sasha_patil: :rocket: approving from product. I'll send the customer email template once kevin confirms.

maria_gomez: Thanks — locking window THU 23:00 PT. If no blockers by 21:45 PT will proceed. tagging @oncall for visibility.
